# Basal

> Basal is a mobile app (iPhone and Android) for tracking calories, macros, weight and strength training. It estimates a person's real daily energy expenditure by comparing what they eat with the trend of their body weight, starting from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation. Basic tracking is free, without ads and without an account; an optional Premium subscription adds a weekly review and advanced analysis. Published by Théo Serrano (sole trader, France). The app interface exists in French, English, Spanish and German; its food database is the French Ciqual table (ANSES).

## Calculators
- [Calcul du métabolisme de base et du TDEE (fr)](https://basal-app.fr/calcul-tdee.html): Mifflin-St Jeor, activity factor 1.2 to 1.9, runs in the browser.
- [Calorie calculator (en)](https://basal-app.fr/en/calorie-calculator.html): same calculation, in English.
- [Calculadora de calorías (es)](https://basal-app.fr/es/calculadora-calorias.html): same calculation, in Spanish.
- [Kalorienrechner (de)](https://basal-app.fr/de/kalorienrechner.html): same calculation, in German.
- [Calculateur de macros (fr)](https://basal-app.fr/calcul-macros.html)
- [Calculer sa dépense réelle (fr)](https://basal-app.fr/calcul-depense-reelle.html): expenditure from intake and weight trend.
